title: Table in card container
description: Embed a full-bleed Table inside a Card with padding turned off and table card usage active. The Card provides container framing and elevation; Table provides structured data rows with seamless edge-to-edge alignment.
useWhen: Presenting tabular datasets, order inventories, ingredient stock levels, or transaction records inside a distinct dashboard surface card.
rules: Set padding={false} on Card to allow Table cells to touch the container perimeter.
Set usage='card' on Table variant='rows' to remove the final divider line for seamless bottom card alignment.
Choose Card surface ('100' | '200' | '300') and surfaceDirection ('lift' | 'depth') to define elevation hierarchy.
Keep columns structured with explicit widths or fractional ratios for predictable desktop rendering.
Provide clear aria-label or visible caption for screen reader accessibility.
